label: min-ripple baseline (200mm / 20p24s)
purpose: Named restore point for MANUAL tuning. The active motor_config.yaml currently equals this design; manual edits will mutate the live config, so this file preserves the min-ripple starting point to compare against / revert to.

operating_point.comment: From motor_config.yaml simulation block (max_current, phase_offset_deg, rpm). Current auto-solves to ~77.7 N.m target via the optimizer; the Simulation runs this fixed 100 A.

metrics_at_target_torque_77_7Nm_log.comment: From the overnight campaign log, at the AUTO-SOLVED current (~107 A) that hits the 77.7 N.m target, steps=120, n_sectors=-1 (old optimizer 'clean ring' build).

metrics_at_simulation_point_100A_g28_ste.comment: Verified 2026-06-17 via verify_nsectors_unify.py at the Simulation's fixed 100 A / gamma 28 / 4000 rpm / steps=120. The two FEM build modes differ by only ~1.7 pp ripple (and the ordering flips run-to-run) -> the spread is mesh noise (~+/-2 pp), not a real design difference; efficiency and torque are identical. The now-unified optimizer/sweep/DOE use n_sectors = mesh.nSectors, exactly like the Simulation tab.
